title: Distance-Residual Physics-Informed Neural Networks: A Deep Learning Framework for Differential and Partial Differential Inclusions
summary: We introduce Distance-Residual Physics-Informed Neural Networks (DR-PINNs), a physics-informed learning framework for approximating solutions of ordinary and partial differential inclusions (DIs), governing laws in which a differential operator is constrained to lie in a set-valued map rather than equaling a prescribed function. The method replaces the classical pointwise PDE/ODE residual by the squared distance from the differential operator to the admissible set.
